messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Jörg. Your Thor P2 order itself is complete on our side: it shipped September 1 and was delivered on September 12.

The parcel still moving is the one you sent back. The customs fees were paid and it was rerouted, but our warehouse hasn't checked it in yet, so there's no arrival date I can give you today.

Your refund and the €86.56 shipping invoice are with the team, and they'll confirm both with you directly.

Hi,
Thank you for the update and for resolving the shipping and customs issues.
Regarding the PayPal dispute: I would like to keep the case open for now, as PayPal rules do not allow a dispute to be reopened once it is closed.
Merchants can issue a refund directly through the PayPal transaction page while a dispute is open, which will automatically close the case safely for both of us. Alternatively, if you process the refund via Shopify, PayPal will automatically resolve and close the dispute as soon as the funds are received.
As soon as the refund appears on my PayPal account, I will immediately confirm and close the case on my end if it hasn't closed automatically.
Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
Best regards,
Jörg
Handed to the team · Refund on a disputed order, only Abel or Georges can decide and process it.
